narrative_alignment_note: Published winner's own OOS-Sharpe-by-lead curve (foreground, VIX/VIX3M) on the DAILY axis; deployed lead 0d = 1.13. Grey bars: best-of-any-signal envelope on the same daily grid. Buy-and-hold SPY = 0.77. On the pair's OWN daily grid the published winner sits at the envelope peak (0d) — both its own curve and the best-of-any-signal envelope peak there, and the profile decays as the signal is lagged. This is a SAME-DAY (coincident) edge — the signal and target move together the same day, not a multi-month leading indicator. Extending the grid to 126/252 trading days surfaces no long-lead edge (long leads fail a t>3 hurdle) — multiple-testing noise.
